incident.title: Range query returns HTTP 422 "unexpected error: runtime error: index out of range [-1]"
incident.description: Since upgrading Prometheus, some range queries that use the anchored or smoothed range-selector modifiers fail with HTTP 422 and the body unexpected error: runtime error: index out of range [-1]. On other inputs the same query returns index out of range [0] with length 0 instead. It happens when the selected series has no samples inside the requested window; queries over series with data in the window succeed. Find the cause.
